title: August and the Letters
author: Wendell Galloway
blurb: Rosalind Vasquez, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
